description: Angular component class for configuring email transformation rules within the Thingsboard platform, including form setup, validation, and configuration handling.

classes.name: ToEmailConfigComponent
classes.description: Angular component for configuring email node settings in rule transformations.

methods.description: Returns the form group for email configuration.
